trigger: visible surface has an exact label card
meaning_policy: return its complete old working reading
provenance_policy: report recipe tier but do not rematch the card as a shell

trigger: all characters are function channels and recipe has an old carrier
provenance_policy: report the strongest old carrier tier

trigger: visible function channels surround a learned core and recipe has an old carrier
meaning_policy: read functions and retain the core as owner-class name
provenance_policy: report the strongest old carrier tier

trigger: visible channels form a bounded atlas recipe without an old whole-recipe carrier
meaning_policy: compose functions and retain any core as owner-class name

trigger: one-sided or other visible function channel shape is outside the bounded atlas
meaning_policy: read visible functions and retain the remainder as owner-class name
provenance_policy: mark outside-atlas; do not erase visible functions

trigger: no function channel but an owner-class family marker matches
meaning_policy: retain family marker and default the whole item to its owner class

trigger: no exact card, function channel or owner-family marker matches
meaning_policy: every character remains inside one owner-class name
provenance_policy: mark outside-atlas with zero carrier counts
